title_en: Poem for Parashat Toledoth Noah Second Qedusha (Go'alenu)
title_he: פיוט לפרשת תולדות נח קדושה שנייה (גואלנו)

content.hebrew: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יו֣י מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם: (תהלים קיג:ב) מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יוָֽי: (תהלים קיג:ג) יו֖י לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב י֜ו֗י מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם: (תהלים כט:י)
content.transliteration: Yehi shem adonai mevorach me‘atta ve‘ad ‘olam: Mimmizraḥ shemesh ‘ad mevo’o mehullal shem Adonai: Adonai lammabbul yashav vayyeshev adonai melech le‘olam:
content.english: May Adonai’s name be blessed from now until eternity. (Ps. 113:2) From the place of the sun’s rising until that of its setting, praised is Adonai’s name. (Ps. 113:3) Adonai was enthroned at the flood, and Adonai remains enthroned as king forever. (Ps. 29:10)

content.hebrew: אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ, הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם,
content.english: O God, O king, who dwells in heaven,

content.hebrew: הַמַּשְׁגִּֽיחַ מִמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּוֹ סַרְעַפָּֽיִם,
content.english: Who looks out from the place of His habitation at [people’s] thoughts,

content.hebrew: רֹצֶה יְרֵאָיו וּבֹחֵר נְקִי כַפָּֽיִם.
content.english: Who is pleased with those that fear Him, and chooses the innocent.

content.hebrew: נִמְצָא וְלֹא בִמְצִיאוּת, חַי וְלֹא בְחַיִּים,
content.transliteration: Nimtsa velo vimtsi’ut, ḥai velo veḥayyim,
content.english: He exists, but outside existence; is alive, but not in life;

content.hebrew: גִּבּוֹר וְלֹא בִגְבוּרָה, וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו בֶּאֱמֶת עֲשׂוּיִם.
content.english: Is mighty, but not in might—and His judgments are made in truth.

content.hebrew: תְּמִים דֵּעִים, וּמִבַּלְעָדָיו לֹא קְנוּיִם.
content.english: He is perfect in His thoughts, and without Him nothing can be created.

content.hebrew: הַמֵּנִֽיחַ לְנֹֽחַ וּבָנָיו, וְהוֹצִיא צִדְקוֹ כַּצָּהֳרָֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Hammeniyaḥ leNowaḥ uvanav, vehotsi tsidḳo kats-tsahorayim.
content.english: [He is] the One who gave rest to Noah and his sons, and brought out his righteousness like broad daylight.

content.hebrew: וְגִלָּה לוֹ סוֹדוֹ לְהָבִיא אִתּוֹ מִכָּל־חַי שְׁנַֽיִם שְׁנָֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Veḡilla lo sodo lehavi itto kol ḥai shenayim shenayim.
content.english: He revealed His secret to him—that he should bring two [specimens] of every living thing with him.

content.hebrew: וְזֶֽרֶם הֶעֱבִיר, וּמָחָה אֶת־כָּל־הַיְקוּם מִתַּֽחַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם,
content.transliteration: Vezerem he‘evir umaḥa et kol haiḳum mittaḥat hash-shamayim,
content.english: And he brought a deluge over [the world], and wiped out all that existed under heaven,

content.hebrew: וַיִשָּֽׁאֶר אַךְ נֹֽחַ וַאֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִשְּׁטִיפַת הַמָּֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Vayyish-shaer ach Nowaḥ va’asher itto mish-shetifat hammayim.
content.english: Such that only Noah, and those who were with him, survived the downpour of water.

content.hebrew: וַיָּֽקֶם יוי עֵדוּת הַקֶּֽשֶׁת לָעֵינָֽיִם,
content.english: Adonai established the visible testimony of the rainbow—

content.hebrew: לֹא תָקוּם צָרָה זוֹ עוֹד פַּעֲמָֽיִם.
content.english: That such a tragedy would not recur a second time.

content.hebrew: יְמֵי הָאָֽרֶץ יֵחָלְקוּ לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽיִם.
content.english: The years of the earth will be divided into four.

content.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ שָׂפָה אַחַת כָּל־גּוֹיִם;
content.english: All the nations were [of] a single language;

content.hebrew: נוֹעֲדוּ בְּנוֹת מִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמָיִם.
content.english: They assembled together to build a tower, with its head in heaven.

content.hebrew: וְנָאַם הַשֵּׁם: "הָֽבָה נֵרְדָה, וְנָבְלָה שָׁם שְׂפָתָֽיִם!"
content.transliteration: Vena’am hash-shem: “hava nereda, venavela sham sefatayim!”
content.english: But the Name said: “Come, let us go down and mix up their languages!”

content.hebrew: וּמִשָּׁם הֱפִיצָם, וּמִבְּנוֹת רָפוּ יָדָיִם.
content.english: And from there He dispersed them, and their hands became too weak to build.

content.hebrew: זָרַח אֶזְרָח כְּאוֹר שֶֽׁמֶשׁ בַּאֲרַם נַהֲרָֽיִם,
content.transliteration: Zaraḥ ezraḥ ke’or shemesh ba’aram naharayim,
content.english: The Ezraḥ shone like sunlight, in Aram Between the Rivers,

content.hebrew: עֲדֵי הֵאִיר מְאוֹר חַמָּה לְשִׁבְעָתָֽיִם.
content.english: Until he was seven times as bright as the sun’s light.

content.hebrew: וְלִישׁוּעַת אֵל שִׁנֵּס מָתְנָֽיִם,
content.english: He girded his loins, [looking forward] to God’s rescue—

content.hebrew: וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל גְּאָלוֹ, וַיֶּֽרֶב אוֹתֹתָיו כִּפְלֵי כִפְלָֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Uḳdosh Yisra’el ge’alo, vayyarev ototav kiflé chiflayim.
content.english: And the Holy One of Israel redeemed him, and made His wonders many, doubled and redoubled.

content.hebrew: כֵּן יִגְאַל זַרְעוֹ מִכָּל־גּוֹי וְעַם צִיִּים,
content.transliteration: Ken yiḡal zar‘o mikkol goy ve‘am tsiyyim,
content.english: So may He redeem his progeny, from every nation and from the boat peoples,

content.hebrew: וְנֹאמַר: בָּרוּךְ גֹּאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל, עֲמוּסֵי מֵעָֽיִם.
content.english: And let us say: Blessed is the redeemer of Israel, who have been carried [by Him ever since] the womb.

content.hebrew: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיה מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Go’alenu adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
